name: Duotone Fade
description: The first clip is printed in two inks, shadows first, as a bold high-contrast duotone; the second clip is printed over it in the same two inks, its dark tones landing before its highlights, then its own colors come back, highlights first. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: shadow_ink
params.description: Ink printed in the shadows (alpha: strength)

params.name: highlight_ink
params.description: Ink printed in the highlights (alpha: strength)

params.name: contrast
params.description: How hard the tones are pushed apart toward the two inks

params.name: grain
params.description: Amount of print grain in the inks and along the handoff
